_description: Application-specific terms, field names, statuses, and domain vocabulary

terms.definition: A Shoppix.me email address auto-assigned to users during registration from a pool in the ActiveSubmissionEmailSelect table.
Database table holding a pool of Shoppix.me email addresses. Each row can be assigned to one AppUser.
Service bus queue that receives CreateUserProfileAsyncCommand messages after registration, forwarding data to DPP and GPM.
Service bus queue that receives scheduled notification messages for the ActiveSubmission email, delivered at 1pm the next day.
Backend service/module handling user profile creation, authentication, and related operations.
Core user entity — contains email, postcode, Facebook/Apple IDs, ActiveSubmissionEmail, tokens, and auth data.
The email entered during registration, stored before email confirmation. Becomes the primary Email after confirmation.
The rewards screen that lists redeemed vouchers and their detail pages.
The monetary value shown for a voucher, such as £5 or £15.
The date or timestamp shown for when the voucher was redeemed.
The unique identifier displayed on the voucher detail page and available for copying.
The CTA that opens the voucher code or redemption experience for supported vouchers.
Call-to-action button within a notification that navigates user to a specific app screen.
Classification of notifications into types with distinct icons: Shelf, Referrals, Reminder, Warning, Voucher.
Backend service responsible for formatting and sending notification payloads to mobile devices.
A placeholder for supporting bulk notifications sent with any text to any user via Manage Shoppix.
Notification triggered when user's account is dropped out (can no longer send receipts).
A Shoppix account created using Facebook sign-in rather than local email/password registration.
A lifecycle action that marks the account inactive while preserving or suspending access as implemented by the app.
A lifecycle action that removes the account or makes it unavailable for future login.
The ledger-like screen that shows earned token credits and the running balance.
The legitimate token credit granted for account registration, distinct from the removed 50-token reward.
The legacy 50-token incentive that was previously awarded for selecting a Shoppix.me email address.
Service bus destination used to propagate account deletion; must not accumulate dead-letter messages.
The survey management area referenced in the ticket where the Launch button behavior is controlled.
A survey status that allows the Launch button to be enabled.
A survey status that allows the Launch button to be enabled.
The survey action button whose availability depends on the survey status.
The external survey identifier that is validated before a survey can be created in Manage Shoppix.
Action used to sync survey records into the Manage Shoppix survey list.
Action used to refresh the survey audience before launch.
The action that launches a survey once the status is eligible.
Survey status that allows the Launch Survey button to be enabled.
Survey status that allows the Launch Survey button to be enabled.
Survey status shown after a successful launch.
Survey status where the Launch Survey button should remain disabled.
The header icon that indicates notifications and navigates to the Notification Centre when tapped.
The visual indicator on the bell icon that shows the number of unread notifications.
Column in the notification configuration spreadsheet that provides the CTA button title.
Yellow CTA style used for scratch/reward notifications.
Dark blue CTA style used for standard action notifications like Start now and View voucher.
Small red circle placed on the top-right of a card's category icon to indicate an unread notification.
Teal-colored border rendered around an unread notification card.
Empty state CTA that starts the receipt snapping flow.
Error state CTA that retries loading notifications.
Retailer linking notification category (e.g. M&S account connected/failed).
